title: Copy/Paste Table Dimensions (Tables)

scenarios.title: Copy/Paste Table Dimensions applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Copy/Paste Table Dimensions (BtnTableDimensions) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Copy/paste table dimensions refuses degenerate input (empty, zero or negative target, non-positive dimension) with the documented exception types
scenarios.expected: oPenEfficiency.Core.Tests drives the host-neutral production code of Copy/Paste Table Dimensions (Tables): TableDimensionScaler.ScaleToTotal is asserted against the real scaling contract - copy/paste table dimensions refuses degenerate input (empty, zero or negative target, non-positive dimension) with the documented exception types.

scenarios.title: Copy/paste table dimensions applies the target total to a single dimension
scenarios.expected: oPenEfficiency.Core.Tests drives the host-neutral production code of Copy/Paste Table Dimensions (Tables): TableDimensionScaler.ScaleToTotal is asserted against the real scaling contract - a single dimension stays a single dimension and takes the target total exactly.

scenarios.title: Copy/Paste Table Dimensions transfers exact widths and heights between real tables
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Copy/Paste Table Dimensions copies a 2x2 source table staged at column widths 80/70 and row heights 40/30 and pastes them onto a differently sized 2x2 target table (120/90 and 55/45 before), leaving the target at exactly widths 80/70 and heights 40/30 (measured targetW=80,70 targetH=40,30 with actuallyChanged=True), both dispatches return true, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.
